name: The Great Cat Spirit

angles.text: As a druid, you take this rite of passage to extend your mastery of the wild beyond the bear.
As a night elf, you answer Cenarius's ancient teachings on Moonglade, ancestral ground for kaldorei druids.
As a tauren, you travel freely to Nighthaven with your night elf brethren under the Cenarion Circle's shared guidance.

aliases: who gives the great cat spirit quest
faq.answer: Your druid trainers send you on behalf of Dendrite Starblaze, an elder mentor in Nighthaven, Moonglade's secluded haven.
faq.q: Who sends for you in The Great Cat Spirit?

faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze lives in Nighthaven, Moonglade's central settlement. Druids can reach it by teleportation.
faq.q: Where can Dendrite Starblaze be found?

faq.answer: Dendrite prepares you to understand and commune with nature's feline aspect, after you have learned the bear's ways.
faq.q: What is the purpose of meeting Dendrite Starblaze?

faq.answer: Dendrite invokes Father Cenarius to honor the demigod and patron of druidism, who taught mortals the secrets of nature and shapeshifting.
faq.q: Why does Dendrite invoke Father Cenarius?

faq.answer: Druids use their spiritual bond with nature to teleport to Moonglade when their mentors call.
faq.q: How do druids travel to Moonglade for this summons?

aliases: cat form vs bear form lore
faq.answer: Druidic teaching approaches nature through different aspects. You first master the bear's enduring strength, then advance to the cat's swift predator's instincts.
faq.q: How does this aspect relate to the bear aspect?

sections.body: Druids who have mastered the enduring bear are summoned to Moonglade again. Elder Dendrite Starblaze calls them to Nighthaven, where they can deepen their communion with nature. Their spiritual gifts carry them across the distance to this haven of Cenarion wisdom.
sections.title: The Summons to Moonglade

sections.body: When you reach Nighthaven, Dendrite Starblaze invokes Father Cenarius and greets you with a faint aura of power. He says it is time to embrace the cat's perspective: swift, agile, and predatory. As before, Dendrite opens the path to understanding, while the work of embodying and spreading the feline spirit rests with you.
sections.title: The Perspective of the Cat

summary: In Nighthaven, druids gather at Dendrite Starblaze's call to learn the cat's ways. They have mastered the bear and now turn to another aspect of the wild under Father Cenarius's blessing.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Great Cat Spirit
